parsed.scene_description: The image depicts a modern, spacious café with high ceilings and large windows. The interior features a mix of contemporary furniture, including clear plastic chairs and round tables. A prominent red cylindrical structure dominates the right side of the frame, possibly serving as a decorative element or functional piece like a pillar or column. The floor is made of polished marble, reflecting light from the ceiling fixtures and windows. Natural light floods in through the expansive glass walls, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. In the background, there are people seated at tables, engaged in conversation or working on laptops, suggesting this space is used for both socializing and productivity. The overall design combines elements of industrial and minimalist aesthetics, with clean lines and a neutral color palette accented by pops of color from the red structure and some greenery visible outside the windows.
